rows.grounds: Fused sandhi form: sarvatra + api + anapekṣaḥ + tu; contrasts with sāpekṣaḥ in prior verse.
Indicates daily recurrence of the prescribed act.
Emphatic or contrastive particle reinforcing the prescription.
States injunction for the practice described.

items.question: Can ritual observance be prescribed daily without dependence in every context?
premises: The prior case was shown to involve dependence on an adopted liṅga.
A state without dependence is applicable in all contexts.
Daily performance is enjoined as the prescribed mode.
items.inference: Therefore ritual observance is prescribed daily in all contexts without dependence.
uncertainties: The exact scope of sarvatra in relation to specific ritual settings is not fully specified.
items.plain_english: But in every case, without dependence, it is prescribed to be performed daily.
